kind: read-only constructed simulation audit; not natural campaign completion

method.spawn: createCampaign + beginEncounter, no manual attack sequence or cooldown changes
method.geometry: flat actual campaign ground; upper platforms/obstacles excluded to isolate pursuit
method.player: stationary fire player at x4800, 1,000,000 QA HP restored between ticks; normal hit invulnerability, statuses, collision and integer hitPlayer remain active
method.profile: none; no persistent saves, equipment, passives or companion
method.environmentHazards: disabled to isolate boss and legitimate summons; native boss zones/projectiles/passives stay active
method.damage: actual HP setter deductions plus real floating-text number; encounter totals include legitimate boss summons, while boss melee hits use that boss attack.victims
method.sampling: every simulation tick for attack/releases/hits/HP; position trace every 0.5 seconds
limitations: QA player pin cancels knockback, gravity and control movement but preserves status timers.
This audit does not test upper platform navigation, cover, dodging, natural progression or subjective art/balance.
Remote transitions ending within final eight seconds may be censored by the 45 second observation window.

interpretation.passedMeaning: All mechanically measured checks pass; this does not approve subjective pursuit timing, difficulty or appearance.

observations.message: Current B07 far-distance pursuit timings are measured in evidence below. Compare these timings when tuning pressure; no subjective acceptance is implied.

The stationary 66-case audit never naturally enters waitingLink. The corrected attack.waitingLink reference is visible in the source, but this branch needs a separate moving-player/forced-range regression if branch coverage is required.
